title: Data Centers Threaten Air Quality Gains in Texas
excerpt: A surge in new data center developments and heavy electricity demand could push Texas air pollution back to levels last seen in the 2000s.
body_html: A rapid increase in new and proposed data centers is driving up electricity demand significantly, potentially reversing years of air quality improvements in Texas. As the state serves as a major hub for the physical infrastructure powering generative AI, the massive energy needs of these facilities threaten to bring air pollution back to levels not seen since the 2000s. How developers and utility companies choose to meet this rising power demand remains a critical factor in the environmental impact.
